    • replaceLocals

      public void replaceLocals(@NonNull Map<Local,Local> replacements)
      Replaces each key of the map by its value, like replaceLocal(Local, Local) for every entry, but in a single pass over the statements: a statement is only rewritten for the locals it uses or defines. Calling replaceLocal(Local, Local) for many locals scans the whole body for each of them.
      Parameters:
      replacements - the locals to replace (compared by identity) and their replacements
